links.outcome: Readability and comprehensibility of LLM answers to IBD patient questions
links.effect: Models were rated satisfactory for comprehensibility overall, but readability differed: Claude-3-Opus answers had better readability than the other two models. No numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: Notably, Claude-3-Opus generated answers with better readability than the other two models.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, readability, and comprehensibility of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4.0, Claude-3-Opus, Gemini-1.5-Pro) for inflammatory bowel disease patient questions using expert and patient raters, without testing a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
